initial_state: first approach observation; encoder offsets applied once
command_time: first matching CAN send on host monotonic clock; zero-order held
controller: logged kp/kd; reconstructed driver feedforward replaces ideal gravity
driver_feedforward_reconstruction: approximate KDL gravity and velocity sign from logged states; held between observations; not actual recorded command
limitations: feedforward is a logged computed command, reconstruction, or omitted; no measured torque
stick/slip force uses inverse mass, not a full constrained contact solve
not a fitted or held-out validated model
